scripts.app:logs: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile app logs -f api web
scripts.db:migrate: npm -w apps/api run prisma:deploy && npm -w apps/api run prisma:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm -w apps/api run dev" "npm -w apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w apps/api run build && npm -w apps/web run build
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.test:e2e: npm -w apps/api run build && npm -w apps/web run test:e2e
scripts.test:contention: npm run db:migrate:test && npm -w apps/api run db:reset:test && npm -w apps/api run build && npx tsx scripts/contention-smoke.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm -w apps/api run typecheck && npm -w apps/web run typecheck && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
